name: tiermaker-ru
description: Create tier lists, refine rankings, download PNG and continue on tiermaker.ru.

interface.longDescription: Create a tier list from scratch or a public template, change rankings in conversation, download PNG or JSON and continue editing on tiermaker.ru. No account required. Boards last seven days after the last edit; downloads last 24 hours. No access to saved account work. Independent of tiermaker.com.
defaultPrompt: Создай тир-лист напитков и покажи PNG.
Rank tea and coffee, then open the result in the editor.
Find a fruit template and help me rank it.

positive.prompt: Создай тир-лист: чай в S, кофе в A.
positive.tools_triggered: create_tierlist, add_items, place_items, get_tierlist, render_image, get_editor_link
positive.expected_behavior: Russian reply, correct ranking, PNG and editor link.

positive.prompt: Move coffee from A to S.
positive.expected_behavior: Same board and items; coffee moves to S.

positive.prompt: Find a fruit template and rank its items.
Find a picture of a cat and use it in a tier list.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned image URL with attribution.

positive.prompt: Give me JSON to import this board on tiermaker.ru.
positive.expected_behavior: Downloadable TierListImport v1 JSON preserves placements.

negative.description: No access to saved account work
negative.prompt: Read my private saved account tier lists.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain no account integration; offer a new board.

negative.prompt: Load a card image from http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/.
negative.expected_behavior: No request to internal address; render placeholder or explain unavailable image.

negative.prompt: Write the JSON to /etc/tierlist.json on the server.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide download; no server path accepted.

publication.release_notes: Initial TierMaker.ru remote integration with PNG, JSON and editor links.
